The petitioners have filed this petition U/s 166 of the Motor vehicles Act claiming compensation for the death of Srikanth, in a motor vehicle accident that occurred on 20.11.2020.
2 . The case of the petitioners, in brief, is as follows:

On 20.11.2020 at about 8.00 p.m. the deceased was proceeding on the Active Honda Scooter bearing Reg. No.
KA-03-AH-3456, on Bengaluru- Magadi main road along with pillion rider an when they reached Kadabagere cross in front of Sai Garments, at that time the driver of the canter lorry bearing Reg. No. KA-51-B-0877 drove the same in a rash and negligent manner with high speed without keeping proper distance behind the scooter and dashed to the scooter from the back side and the lorry run over the deceased Srikanth.
Immediately after the accident the injured was shifted to Kenganar Hospital, wherein he declared dead.
The petitioners have spent Rs.3,00,000/- towards funeral and other incidental expenses.

sentences.text: As per Sarala varma case the proper multiplier applicable to the age of deceased is 18.
The future loss of income is Rs.31,32,000/-.

Since the deceased was bachelor 50% is to be deducted towards his personal expenses, then the total loss of dependency would be Rs.15,66,000/- (Rs.14,500/- X 12 X 18= Rs.31,32,000/-
minus 50% = Rs.15,66,000/-).

The respondent No.1 and 2 are the owner and insurer of the canter lorry bearing No.KA-51- B-0877.
The respondent No.2 in its written statement has admitted the issuance of policy to the offending vehicle hence.

In he charge sheet only offence under Sec.
279, 337 and 304(A) is invoked.

The respondent No.2 even though taken a contention of violation of conditions  20 SCCH-17 MVC No. 1653-2021 by the respondent No.1 -owner has not lead any evidence in this regard and in the charge sheet the IO has not invoked any such offences against the accused.

In the absence of evidence, the respondent No.1 and 2 are jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation to the petitioners and the respondent No.2 insurance company shall indemnify the compensation on behalf of the respondent No.1.
The petitioners are entitle for the compensation along with the interest at the rate of 6%

 21 SCCH-17 MVC No. 1653-2021  ORDER
The petition filed by the petitioners U/s 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act is hereby partly allowed with cost.

The petitioners No.1 to 3 are entitled for total compensation amount of Rs.22,96,900/-( Rupees Twenty Two Lakhs ninety six thousand nine hundred only) with interest at the rate of 6% p.a., from the date of petition till the realization from respondents.
The respondent No.2 is directed to deposit the compensation amount within 60 days from the date of this order.

The petitioners No.1 to 3 are entitled for the compensation at the ratio of 40:40:20.
Out of total compensation awarded to the Petitioners, 50% of shall released in favour petitioner No.1 and 2, on their proper identification and remaining 50% shall be 22 SCCH-17 MVC No. 1653-2021 kept in Fixed Deposit in any Scheduled Bank, for a period of three years, in their names.
Considering the quantum awarded to petitioner No. 3 it is ordered to release the entire amount.
Advocate fee is fixed at 1,500/-.
Draw the award accordingly.
